details.biography:
Satoshi Urushihara (うるし原 智志 (pen name) or 漆原 智志 (real name) Urushihara Satoshi, February 9, 1966), the "Master of Breasts", is a Japanese manga artist and illustrator known for his distinctive style of beautiful characters. His work is the basis for anime such as Plastic Little and Legend of Lemnear, and appears in the Langrisser and Growlanser series of tactical role-playing video games.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
